title: Grateful Dead Live at Onongada County War Memorial on 1982-04-08
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DRAGON => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit / 5.8 MHz Stereo] >> Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M > MAC. Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = Maxell UDXLII-S Analog

ai_review.summary: Front‑of‑house tape captures a fat, upfront sound, but the show splits opinion – praised for the Playing in the Band → Uncle John’s Band transition yet criticized as a lackluster ’82 performance.
ai_review.review: The FOB recording is lauded for its strong presence and clarity, delivering a surprisingly rich listening experience despite the inherent audience bleed. Musically the concert is polarizing: some listeners cherish the seamless Playin‑>UJB sequence, while others describe the entire set as one of the weakest of the decade.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is divided (average to below average) while recording quality is consistently praised, yielding a mid‑range overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very fat and upfront sound with strong presence; typical FOB vocal bleed noted during 'Friend of the Devil' but no major flaws.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band → Uncle John's Band
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is highlighted by a smooth transition from Playing in the Band into Uncle John’s Band; otherwise opinions on pacing and overall energy vary widely.
